verses.text: The word of YHWH that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem.

segments.text: The word of YHWH that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem.

verses.text: Hear, O peoples, all of them! Pay attention, O earth, and its fullness! And may the Lord YHWH be against you⁺ as a witness—the Lord from the temple of His holiness!

segments.text: Hear, O peoples, all of them! Pay attention, O earth, and its fullness! And may the Lord YHWH be against you⁺ as a witness—the Lord from the temple of His holiness!

verses.text: For behold, YHWH is coming from His station. He will come down and will tread upon the high places of the earth.

segments.text: For behold, YHWH is coming from His station. He will come down and will tread upon the high places of the earth.

verses.text: And the mountains will melt under Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the face of the fire, like waters poured down on a slope.

segments.text: And the mountains will melt under Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the face of the fire, like waters poured down on a slope.

verses.text: All this [is] for the transgression of Jacob and for the sins of the house of Israel. What [is] the transgression of Jacob? Is [it] not Samaria? And what [are] the high places of Judah? Are [they] not Jerusalem?

segments.text: All this [is] for the transgression of Jacob and for the sins of the house of Israel. What [is] the transgression of Jacob? Is [it] not Samaria? And what [are] the high places of Judah? Are [they] not Jerusalem?

verses.text: And I will set Samaria as a heap of ruins in the field, a planting area of a vineyard; I will pour down her stones into the valley, and her foundations I will uncover.

segments.text: And I will set Samaria as a heap of ruins in the field, a planting area of a vineyard; I will pour down her stones into the valley, and her foundations I will uncover.

verses.text: And all her carved images will be crushed, and all her wages will be burned in the fire, and all her idols I will set [as] a desolation. For from the wages of a prostitute she gathered [it], and to the wages of a prostitute they will return!

segments.text: And all her carved images will be crushed, and all her wages will be burned in the fire, and all her idols I will set [as] a desolation. For from the wages of a prostitute she gathered [it], and to the wages of a prostitute they will return!

verses.text: Over this I will mourn and wail, I will go barefoot and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals, and a lamentation like the daughters of the ostrich.

segments.text: Over this I will mourn and wail, I will go barefoot and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals, and a lamentation like the daughters of the ostrich.

verses.text: For her wounds [are] incurable, for it has come to Judah; it has reached even to the gate of My people, to Jerusalem.

segments.text: For her wounds [are] incurable, for it has come to Judah; it has reached even to the gate of My people, to Jerusalem.

verses.text: Do not declare [it] in Gath, do not weep at all weep; in Beth-leaphrah, roll yourself in the dust.

segments.text: Do not declare [it] in Gath, do not weep at all weep; in Beth-leaphrah, roll yourself in the dust.

verses.text: Pass by for yourself, O dweller of Shaphir, in shameful nakedness. She does not come out—the dweller of Zaanan; the mourning of Beth-ezel will take away from you⁺ its station.

segments.text: Pass by for yourself, O dweller of Shaphir, in shameful nakedness. She does not come out—the dweller of Zaanan; the mourning of Beth-ezel will take away from you⁺ its station.

verses.text: For the dweller of Maroth has waited anxiously for good, because calamity has come down from YHWH to the gate of Jerusalem!

segments.text: For the dweller of Maroth has waited anxiously for good, because calamity has come down from YHWH to the gate of Jerusalem!

verses.text: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, O dweller of Lachish! She [was] the beginning of sin for the daughter of Zion, for in you were found the transgressions of Israel.

segments.text: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, O dweller of Lachish! She [was] the beginning of sin for the daughter of Zion, for in you were found the transgressions of Israel.

verses.text: Therefore you will give farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib [are] a deceit to the kings of Israel.

segments.text: Therefore you will give farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib [are] a deceit to the kings of Israel.

verses.text: Again the possessor I will bring to you, O dweller of Mareshah; to Adullam will come the glory of Israel.

segments.text: Again the possessor I will bring to you, O dweller of Mareshah; to Adullam will come the glory of Israel.

verses.text: Make yourself bald and shear [your head] over the children of your delight; enlarge your baldness like an eagle, for they will go into exile away from you.

segments.text: Make yourself bald and shear [your head] over the children of your delight; enlarge your baldness like an eagle, for they will go into exile away from you.
